outcome: Incidence of very low birth weight
Incidence of extremely low birth weight
cohort: The study compared 44 dichorionic-triamniotic (DC) triplets to 46 trichorionic (TC) triplets.
finding: Dichorionic-triamniotic (DC) triplets were not significantly disadvantaged compared to trichorionic (TC) triplets regarding perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were similar between the dichorionic-triamniotic and trichorionic triplet groups.
followup_time: Up to the early neonatal period
birth_weight: Very low birth weight and extremely low birth weight were evaluated.
gest_age: Birth at <32 weeks and <28 weeks gestation was evaluated.
